name: Glute Bridge
description: Strengthens the glutes: lying on your back with knees bent, squeeze your buttocks and lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders.

source.title: Glute Bridge (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart, arms by your sides.
cues: Squeeze your glutes to lift, not your lower back.
Stop when your knees, hips and shoulders line up.
Lower one vertebra at a time.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Lie on your back
keyframes.cue: Knees bent, feet flat, arms by your sides.
